annotations.title: Galápagos park fee and entry rules

description: Use this for the Galápagos national park entrance fee, the transit control card (TCT) and the entry and visitor rules: fee by nationality group and age, total for a group, where and when each is paid, return ticket, health insurance, stay limit, biosecurity (banned food and plant items), naturalist guides, the 2-metre rule, drones, currency and ATMs, each with its official source. Examples: "How much is the Galápagos park fee for a family of four?" / "¿Cuánto cuesta la entrada al Parque Nacional Galápagos?"

children_under_2.description: Children under 2, exempt from the park fee (default 0).

nationality.description: foreign (default), canmercosur (national of a CAN or Mercosur country) or resident (Ecuadorian or resident).
